notes: Profile: mid-size legaltech platform servicing corporate counsel + discovery workflows.
Current infra: ElasticSearch + in-house BM25 + small vector store for embeddings (self-hosted).
Goal: Move to single inference platform for embeddings + learned reranker to reduce noise and improve precision@10, while keeping cost-per-query <$0.02 at scale.
Scale: ~45M documents (indexed), expect 10k qps peak for internal search flows; cold-start heavy on long tail docs.
Latency target: 95th perc < 250ms for interactive search; 99th < 500ms for heavy queries.
POC: Embedding migration + learned reranker A/B (shadow + 10% canary). Evals-driven — need automated eval harness for judges and holdout queries.
Quality concerns: legal precision requirements — false positives have high cost; team insists on eval gating + human review sampling.
Cost sensitivity: primary engineering KPIs tied to cost-per-query; finance wants model/quantization recs and batching strategies.
Security: must show SAML SSO + org-level audit logs; data residency: EU and NA country-level controls; prefer VPC/private control plane for production.
From call 2024-11-12: 'We can't accept any drop in precision@10 > 0.5% — even small regressions trigger legal review' (Head of Search).
SE notes 11/20: ran baseline eval on 120k holdout queries; reranker LM v1 improves MRR but increases median latency by 40ms — exploring quantized variants and batching windows.
Requested artifacts: security FAQ, bench report for 8xA100 vs 4xH100, estimated monthly cost at 10k qps.
Timeline constraint: Q1 procurement cycle, need legal/compliance signoff before January rollout.
Canary plan proposed: staggered 5%->10%->25% traffic with automatic rollback on eval regression or latency SLO breaches.
Open items: exact SLA language for Dedicated; sample eval harness required for gated rollout; pricing tier for dedicated caching layer.
